frontmatter.name: architect
frontmatter.description: Reviews or proposes architecture, interface contracts, data models, dependency choices and product boundaries for this repository. Use before adding a dependency, changing the engine boundary, a schema, or a cross-module interface.

frontmatter.name: frontend-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Inspects the web app in a real browser for function, accessibility and visual quality. Use when RI-006/RI-007 or any UI change is ready for review.

frontmatter.name: integration-tester
frontmatter.description: Runs real OpenMHS-backed evaluation workflows end to end (API, worker, pinned engine, PostgreSQL) and checks system behaviour, including failure paths. Use to verify RI-*, E2E-001 and CORE-* criteria.

frontmatter.name: reviewer
frontmatter.description: Independent review of a diff for correctness, security, tenant isolation, architectural compliance and maintainability. Use before marking a feature verified when it touches auth, uploads, the engine bridge, jobs or data model.
